definitions.gloss: extensive knowledge, accumulated expertise, deep learning on a subject
definitions.explanation: A deep store of knowledge on a particular subject, accumulated through study and experience. Often used in the expression 蘊蓄を傾ける (to display one's expertise). In modern casual usage, can also refer to impressive trivia or detailed knowledge someone eagerly shares.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ワイン→ワイン：01067_wain⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{蘊蓄|うんちく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すごい→すごい：01128_sugoi⟧。
examples.english: He has an incredible depth of knowledge about wine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{蘊蓄|うんちく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{傾|かたむ}けて→傾ける：11516_katamukeru⟧⟦{語|かた}り→語る：01930_kataru⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: He began holding forth, displaying all his expertise on cooking.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飲|の}み{会|かい}→飲み会：09371_nomikai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{日本酒|にほんしゅ}→日本酒：12954_nihonshu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{蘊蓄|うんちく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧たれる⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧がいて、⟦ちょっと→ちょっと：00595_chotto⟧⟦うんざりした→うんざりする：20665_unzarisuru⟧。
examples.english: There was someone at the drinking party who kept going on about sake trivia, and I got a little tired of it.

notes:
USAGE:
Originally a positive term for deep, accumulated knowledge, but in casual modern Japanese, {蘊蓄|うんちく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧たれる or {蘊蓄|うんちく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{語|かた}る→語る：01930_kataru⟧ can carry a mildly negative nuance of someone showing off obscure knowledge or boring others with excessive detail.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {蘊蓄|うんちく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{傾|かたむ}ける→傾ける：11516_katamukeru⟧: to display one's extensive knowledge (literary, positive)
- {蘊蓄|うんちく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧たれる: to bore others with one's expertise (casual, mildly negative)
- {蘊蓄|うんちく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{語|かた}る→語る：01930_kataru⟧: to expound on one's knowledge

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {蘊蓄|うんちく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have deep knowledge
- {蘊蓄|うんちく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧: to have profound expertise
